item: The boot's rollup step reports the outcome of the build it waited for, and the boot tests restore the module state
summary: Follow-up to PR #1305's third review. A boot step that waited on a build a serve had kicked showed done even when that build declined or failed; the build now records its outcome while it holds the lock and the waiter reports it. Two new boot tests left the module state set (a later map test failed under a different order); an autouse fixture restores it.
